title: 第十一章 超梦第十二章 封弊者
content_zh:
超梦头盔。
一个能让意识潜行入虚拟现实的设备。
这东西并不是便宜货，最次的也得上万，但是各种毛病，体验极其不佳。
中端一点得需要十几二十万，高档货更是不设上限，完美复现所有感官。
虽然刘子文家里是开网吧的，在21层属于是中产阶级，但并没富裕到开全是超梦头盔的网吧。
还是以一些复古的游戏机和pc为主，超梦头盔也都是中低端产品，只有三十台。
虽然不是大富之家。
但这个网吧也给刘子文的家庭带来可观的收益，可以支撑他的高校学费，在攀比严重的远越高校，在鄙视链里也处于相对上游的位置。
之所以刘子文疯魔道痴，是因为不爽那些更有钱的同学那副逼脸，他自诩为品德高尚，自己以下人人平等，自己以上等级森严，要扫除一切害人虫。
“怎么样，虽然比起那些狗资本家的超梦电竞馆差点，但算是这一片比较有档次的网吧了。”
刘子文说这句话的时候神情并不自得。
他也知道他老爹是靠着举债开的这家网吧，楼层租金，按揭贷款，人员雇佣，要是经营不善，资金链断裂，到了方舱的[斩杀线]，也不知道是当流浪汉还是去当街头混子。
网吧内采用香槟金为主色的轻奢装潢风格，柜员网管也都是年轻漂亮的妹妹。
王庆却有些顾虑。
在灵能工业课程上，他已经知道了进入虚拟现实的并不是自己的元神，而是通过生物电在虚拟世界复现的延伸感官。
现在的技术对元神这种东西依然无法触及。
但也只是理论上。
如果游戏服务器有什么特殊手段，自己至尊境的神魂被某种方式探测到了，驻地反恐部队都是小事，定会惊动天庭高层。
小心为妙。
刘子文和女网管是食人部落bbq，老熟人了，开了两台机器，自然是无需付费的，网吧都是他家的。

“对了，我没有账号，可不可以借一个？”
王庆不是很喜欢实名制这个玩意儿。
“注册一个不就行了，快得很，又不是升级打怪的角色扮演游戏，虚界是纯pvp的。”
刘子文等不及要虐一虐王庆了，安芷居然对他有意思，简直不可思议。
“我不想注册。”
王庆想要在一定程度上逃避监管。
超梦。
分为正常的超梦网络，和黑超梦。
本质上是没有区分的，只在于使用途径。
这种人机互嵌的虚拟现实技术，不仅用于游戏，还支持超梦电影。
可通过植入录制模块，记录感官数据，制作第一视角体验的超梦电影，完全身临其境，和明星艺人享受惊心动魄的电影桥段。
两者都受到相当程度的监管，来杜绝违法犯罪，暴力体验大幅度删减，性体验更是一点没有，使用过程中必须一直联网。
破解超梦头盔使其离线运行，或者局域互联，是违法的。
那么就有了黑超梦。
一些犯罪者会录制非法内容，包含极端暴力和变态涩情，亦或者两者具有。往往编辑质量极低，还残存着罪犯或受害者的极端情绪和未处理残存思维。
体验这类超梦会对大脑带来损伤，尽管危险不被法律允许，依旧存在部分群体趋之若鹜，甚至有组织专门制作直播各类违法活动。
因特殊性不在市面上流通，多数只能通过帮派控制的地下黑市、演播厅来体验黑超梦。
但最恐怖的是……
content_en:
Mewtwo helmet.
A device that allows consciousness to sneak into virtual reality.
This thing is not cheap, at least it costs tens of thousands, but it has all kinds of problems and the experience is extremely poor.
Mid-range products cost more than ten or two hundred thousand, and there is no upper limit for high-end products, which can perfectly reproduce all senses.
Although Liu Ziwen's family owns an Internet cafe and belongs to the middle class on the 21st floor, he is not wealthy enough to open an Internet cafe full of Mewtwo helmets.
Still mainly based on some retro game consoles and PCs, Mewtwo helmets are also mid-to-low-end products, with only thirty units.
Although it is not a wealthy family.
But this Internet cafe has also brought considerable income to Liu Ziwen's family, which can support his college tuition. In Yueyue University, where competition is serious, it is also in a relatively upstream position in the contempt chain.
The reason why Liu Ziwen is crazy and crazy is because he is dissatisfied with the ugly faces of his richer classmates. He prides himself on being of high moral character, and everyone below him is equal, while above him there is a strict hierarchy and he wants to eliminate all harmful insects.
"How about it? Although it's not as good as the Chaomeng E-Sports Arena of those dog capitalists, it can be regarded as a relatively high-end Internet cafe in this area."
Liu Ziwen didn't look proud when he said this.
He also knew that his father relied on borrowing money to open this Internet cafe, floor rent, mortgage loans, and personnel hiring. If it was not managed well and the capital chain was broken, he would not know whether he would become a homeless person or a street gangster if he reached the "killing line" of the shelter.
The Internet cafe adopts a light and luxurious decoration style with champagne gold as the main color, and the tellers and network managers are all young and beautiful sisters.
Wang Qing was a little worried.
In the psychic industry course, he already knew that it was not his soul that entered virtual reality, but the extended senses that reproduced in the virtual world through bioelectricity.
Current technology is still inaccessible to things like Yuan Shen.
But that's only in theory.
If the game server has any special means, and his soul in the Supreme Realm is detected in some way, even if it is a trivial matter for the anti-terrorist troops stationed there, the higher-ups in Heaven will be alarmed.
It's better to be careful.
Liu Ziwen and the female network administrator were old acquaintances from the cannibal tribe BBQ. They opened two machines, so there was no need to pay. The Internet cafes were all owned by him.
"By the way, I don't have an account, can I borrow one?"
Wang Qing doesn't like the real-name system very much.
"Just register one. It's very fast. It's not a role-playing game about upgrading and fighting monsters. Virtual World is purely about PVP."
Liu Ziwen couldn't wait to torture Wang Qing. It was incredible that An Zhi was interested in him.
"I don't want to sign up."
Wang Qing wants to evade supervision to a certain extent.
Mewtwo.
It is divided into normal Mewtwo network and black Mewtwo network.
There is essentially no distinction, it just depends on the way of use.
This kind of human-machine embedded virtual reality technology is not only used for games, but also supports the Mewtwo movie.
By implanting the recording module, you can record sensory data and create a first-person experience of a Mewtwo movie. You can be completely immersed in the scene and enjoy thrilling movie scenes with celebrities and artists.
Both are subject to a considerable degree of supervision to prevent illegal crimes. Violent experiences are greatly deleted, and sexual experiences are not available at all. You must be online at all times during use.
It is illegal to crack the Mewtwo helmet so that it can run offline or connect to a local area.
Then there is Black Mewtwo.
Some criminals record illegal content that includes extreme violence, perverted erotica, or both. The editing quality is often very low, and the extreme emotions and unprocessed residual thoughts of the criminal or victim remain.
Experiencing this kind of super dream will cause damage to the brain. Although the danger is not allowed by law, there are still some groups who flock to it, and there are even organizations that specialize in live broadcasts of various illegal activities.
Due to its special nature, it is not circulated in the market. Most people can only experience Black Mewtwo through underground black markets and studios controlled by gangs.
But the scariest thing is...
